objective: Connect Qwen3-ASR-1.7B, run English/Japanese/code-switch accuracy and end-to-end latency evaluation, and produce authoritative evidence without iterative ad-hoc correction.

non_goals: alternative ASR model selection unless a hard branch trigger fires

preconditions.condition: model weights resolvable from local cache or approved source
test audio fixtures and references are present and checksummed

execution_phases.name: runtime_validation
execution_phases.exit: all required runtime dependencies for selected test mode are satisfied

execution_phases.name: model_smoke
execution_phases.exit: model loads and produces valid transcript for both languages

execution_phases.name: latency_suite
actions: measure first partial and release-to-final latency

branch_logic.action: Do not modify application code. Produce BLOCKED with exact runtime mismatch and required environment delta.
Do not substitute another ASR. Produce BLOCKED with dependency inventory and install manifest.

branch_logic.trigger: offline works but vLLM streaming runtime is unavailable
branch_logic.action: Complete offline accuracy/resource suites, mark streaming latency ACs BLOCKED, and do not claim streaming PASS.

branch_logic.trigger: weights unavailable or model load fails before inference
branch_logic.action: Classify as infrastructure/model-loading failure, preserve logs, no fallback model.
Run predefined ablations only: dictionary/context/normalization. If raw ASR remains below threshold, disposition=REFRAME and open alternative-model comparison gate.

branch_logic.trigger: AC6 or AC7 fails while accuracy passes
branch_logic.action: Keep Qwen as accuracy baseline; profile load/inference/normalization/insertion stages. Permit optimization of runtime path only. Do not change model until stage attribution is complete.
Disable offending context source and re-run the predefined paired ablation once. If harm persists, fail that feature while preserving base dictation path.
REJECT normalization policy immediately; raw ASR remains testable but final-text feature cannot PASS.

branch_logic.trigger: all hard P0 ACs pass or non-applicable ACs are explicitly BLOCKED by environment with no false PASS
branch_logic.action: Freeze baseline hashes and mark Qwen MVP baseline accepted.

evidence_contract.fail_closed: Any missing mandatory evidence prevents CLOSED/PASS.

tcc_rules: No ad-hoc parameter changes between fixtures.
No model swap unless branch trigger permits it.
No threshold changes after seeing results.
No PASS from subjective listening alone.
Environment failures are BLOCKED, not model failures.
All reruns must reuse frozen fixtures and record a new evidence set.
